download.title: Obli.tools
download.description:
A lightweight native interface that groups all your Obli apps into one window.
Get sound notifications and a distraction-free monitoring experience.
download.step1: On first launch, enter your Obliview server URL. Linked apps (Obliguard, Oblimap, Obliance) are discovered automatically.
download.step2: Each app opens in its own native tab — no browser overhead, no address bar, sessions are preserved when switching tabs.
download.step3: Sound notifications play when a probe goes down/up or an agent threshold is breached/cleared.
download.step4: Click the ⚙ gear icon (bottom-right corner) to change the server URL at any time.
download.step5: No rebuild is needed after Obliview updates — the app always loads the latest web UI.

agentUpdatePolicy.description: Automatic: agents are queued into the paced rollout as soon as a newer version is served. Manual: an admin starts updates. Frozen: no update at all, even manual ("off" at any level wins over everything below it).
agentUpdatePolicy.groupDesc: Update policy of the agents of this group and of its sub-groups. Each agent can override it, except when a level above freezes updates.
agentUpdatePolicy.globalDesc: Applies to every workspace unless a workspace, a group or an agent overrides it. Frozen here is the fleet-wide kill-switch: no agent is updated, even manually, and waiting updates are cancelled. Workspaces are set on the Workspace page, groups on their settings page.
agentUpdatePolicy.summaryDesc: Groups (group settings page) and agents (agent page) can override it. Frozen at any level wins: those agents are never updated, not even by this rollout.
agentUpdatePolicy.rolloutCounts: Outdated agents with update policy Automatic: {{auto}} (queued on their own) · Frozen: {{frozen}} (never updated, not counted above)
